ui_bugs.issue: Monthly EMI renders raw decimals when value < Rs1,00,000 e.g. 'Rs62,106.574' / 'Rs85,975.602' (inr() only rounds in the Cr/L branches, falls through to toLocaleString with no maximumFractionDigits). Affects emi-monthly, total interest and any currency under Rs1L across the app.

issues: The two large liquid blobs (#FFD84D/40 to #00FFE1/25) sit over the narrow mobile hero, so the top-right half reads olive-green/teal rather than deep navy — theme intent is muddied at small widths. Consider reducing blob opacity/size below md.
Same yellow/teal blob wash makes the navy auth background look green-tinted; large empty vertical space above the Sign in card (carried over from iteration_3).

action_items: Round currency in lib/format.js inr() (use maximumFractionDigits: 0 in the toLocaleString branch) so Monthly EMI shows Rs62,107 not Rs62,106.574.
Optional: tone down hero liquid blobs at <md widths so the mobile hero stays Navy instead of reading green/teal.

rca_of_the_issue: EMI decimal defect RCA: lib/format.js inr() rounds to 2dp only for Cr (>=1e7) and L (>=1e5); values below Rs1L hit `abs.toLocaleString('en-IN')` which keeps up to 3 fraction digits, so the unrounded EMI float leaks decimals into emi-monthly. Fix: pass {maximumFractionDigits: 0} (or Math.round) in that branch.
